attribution: Hammarström, Harald; Forkel, Robert; Haspelmath, Martin; Bank, Sebastian (2026). Glottolog 5.3. Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology.
method: Level=language; Macroarea=Africa; finite source coordinates within [-26,-36,64,38]; exclude Bookkeeping, Unattested and Sign Language; retain independently classified families, isolates and Pidgin as a distinct contact-language category. Coordinates rounded to five decimal places; no invented residence areas or density weighting.
measure: Language documentation locations, not ethnicity, speaker counts or residence boundaries.
